dataset: Listed Buildings as polygons - Open Data Hub download index
evidence_slice: Historic England's official Open Data Hub download page states that National Heritage List for England data is available through the Open Data Hub in multiple formats and APIs, that GIS spatial data is published by Historic England under the Open Government Licence, and that the 'Listed Buildings as polygons' product was last updated 6 October 2026. The selected page is a product/download index only: it does not expose an individual Exeter listed-building feature, footprint coordinates, or record-bound building name/type-use fields.

field_evidence.footprint: Official publisher page confirms a Listed Buildings polygon product, but the selected download-index window contains no individual Exeter Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: The selected download-index window does not expose a record-bound Exeter building name/type/use payload.
field_evidence.source_scope: Historic England publisher-owned Open Data Hub download index; official public no-login source-area metadata only.
